responses.draft_cover_letter:
I am excited about the opportunity to join Ironbridge Manufacturing as a .NET Developer and contribute to your team in Telford.  

While I have not yet worked directly with C# .NET 8, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework, or Azure DevOps pipelines, I am eager to learn these technologies and confident in my ability to acquire them quickly. My commitment to delivering reliable software and my enthusiasm for tackling new challenges will enable me to become productive in this role promptly.  

Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to discussing how I can support Ironbridge Manufacturing’s development goals.
